name: Wheel of Fortune
intro: The Wheel of Fortune pathway manipulates luck, probability and calamity. Its power is volatile, making favorable outcomes possible while turning misfortune into a weapon.

meter.name: Fortune
meter.full: Retry once or punish a failed enemy attack
meter.quirkText: Survival: Danger Sense [Escape], Lucky Break [Defense], Reset Fate [Heal]

ability.name: Danger Sense
ability.label: Passive
ability.description: Danger Sense — Reduces incoming all damage by 15% after shields; +15 percentage points Dodge. Passive.

ability.name: Bad Luck Curse
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Bad Luck Curse — Prevents critical hits on the target’s next damaging action; If the resolved cast deals no damage, follows its utility effects with a 35% basic strike against the current enemy. 15 SP · Cooldown 2 turns.

ability.name: Lucky Break
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Lucky Break — Forces the target's next damaging action to miss with 100% chance; At 100 charge, retry one failed hit contest using the same chance for 2 turns; forced misses still apply.; If the resolved cast deals no damage, follows its utility effects with a 35% basic strike against the current enemy. 25 SP · Cooldown 3 turns.

ability.name: Misfortune Aura
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Misfortune Aura — Enemy SPEED −20% for 2 turns; Lowers target accuracy by 20 percentage points for 2 turns; Mark misfortune for 3 turns: a failed attack or damaging ability causes 150% of the caster's INT as Psychic backlash, once per action.; If the resolved cast deals no damage, follows its utility effects with a 35% basic strike against the current enemy. 25 SP · Cooldown 3 turns.

ability.name: Reset Fate
ability.label: Passive Revival
ability.description: Reset Fate — Automatically revives once per battle at 35% Max HP. Passive.

ability.name: Misfortune Inversion
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Misfortune Inversion — Removes Burn, Bleed, Poison, Curse, Curse link, Silenced, Confused, Sleep, Stunned, Frozen, Freeze, Bound; +20% ATK for 2 turns; +20% INT for 2 turns; If the resolved cast deals no damage, follows its utility effects with a 35% basic strike against the current enemy. 50 SP · Cooldown 3 turns.

ability.name: Chaos Probability
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Chaos Probability — Targets all enemies; Target skills have a 40% misfire chance for 2 turns; SP and cooldown are still spent; If the resolved cast deals no damage, follows its utility effects with a 35% basic strike against the current enemy. 70 SP · Cooldown 4 turns.

ability.name: Reincarnation Loop
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Reincarnation Loop — Restore HP and timed buffs and debuffs from two rounds earlier; preserve SP, cooldowns, survival counters and form uses. At 100 charge, Perfect Loop keeps your current buffs, adds the earlier ones and clears every debuff. Healing prohibition blocks HP recovery.; If the resolved cast deals no damage, follows its utility effects with a 35% basic strike against the current enemy. 85 SP · Cooldown 4 turns.

ability.name: Snake of Mercury
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Snake of Mercury — Deals 300% INT Fate damage (25% base DEF bypass); For 2 turns, a fate skin revives you from one lethal blow at 10% Max HP; Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 100 SP · Cooldown 4 turns.

ability.name: Wheel of Destiny
ability.label: Active Authority
ability.description: Wheel of Destiny — Targets all enemies; Deals 390% INT True damage (ignores DEF and elemental resistance); Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 120 SP · Cooldown 5 turns.
